description: Defines the RawPngData class providing methods for pixel data indexing and retrieval from raw PNG byte arrays, including palette handling and pixel conversion.

classes.name: RawPngData
classes.description: Provides convenience methods for indexing into a raw byte array to extract pixel values, handling different color types, bit depths, and palette-based images.

methods.name: GetPixelIndex
methods.description: Calculates the pixel index at given (x, y) coordinates, considering palette and bit depth.

methods.name: GetPixel
methods.description: Retrieves the Pixel object at specified (x, y), decoding based on bytes per pixel, color type, and palette.

methods.name: ToSingleByte
methods.description: Converts two bytes into a single byte representing a grayscale value.

methods.name: GetPalette
methods.description: Returns the palette associated with the image, if any.
